lines.en: I bounce forward in hops.

lines.zh: 我在地上弹了两下，靠近。
lines.en: I bounce twice on the ground and close in.
My body squashes and springs.

lines.zh: 我跳过一块糖壳，黏住了。
lines.en: I hop over a candy shell and stick.

lines.zh: 我在焦糖里滑了一小段。
lines.en: I slide a stretch in the caramel.

lines.zh: 我从石头上弹到你那边。
lines.en: I spring off the stone your way.
I trail a sticky line.

lines.zh: 我一边弹一边长大一点。
lines.en: With each bounce I grow a little.
I don't jump high, but I'm eager.
I hit the ground and bounce up.
I bounce along the candy wall.
My shape keeps changing.
I roll across a stretch of syrup.

lines.zh: 我弹不上台阶，只能贴上去。
lines.en: I can't hop the step; I flow over it.

lines.zh: 我落在你的影子里，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I land in your shadow and creep closer.
My edges drag on the ground.
I slump on the ground, slowly flowing.
My surface is glossy and sticky.
I'm hardening slightly.
I draw a bit of sugar in.
I jiggle once, and sweetness spreads.
I wait for someone to step here.
There are bubbles inside me.
I press to the floor; it's cool.
I'm slowly reforming.
The cave smells sweet; I can tell.
I spread myself wider.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，糖浆滴了一点。
lines.en: I wobble, and a drop of syrup falls.
You've stepped into the candy cave.
I bounce once at you.
No sugar on you; a pity.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的鞋底，那里最黏。
lines.en: I watch your soles; that's the sticky spot.
I bounce a little to see you.
Run, and I'll keep up.

lines.zh: 糖壳映出你的样子，变形了。
lines.en: My sugar shell mirrors you, warped and stretched.
Your boots will stick.
I jiggle and come nearer.
Hard to stand in syrup, isn't it?

lines.zh: 我塌下去一块，又鼓回来。
lines.en: I sag and then plump back.
My whole mass is quivering.
I pull back a step, leaving stickiness.
That punched through me.
My sugar thinned a little.
I don't cry out; I only wobble.
I press to the floor and slowly gather.
A part of me stayed behind.
I've gone softer, and stickier.
I can still bounce.
The smell of sugar, fresh.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西是甜的吗？
lines.en: Is that sweet in your hand?
I roll a little your way.
That syrup; I'll absorb it.
I smell sugar under your feet.
Stand there a moment and I'm there.
I reach out a little and touch.
All the sweet things come to me.
I creep over, sticky.
Just drop the sugar.

lines.zh: 你一脚陷进来，拔不出去。
lines.en: Your foot sinks into me and won't pull free.
I'm knocked apart a little and gather.
I bounce into your knee.
I've caught your sole.
We collide, and syrup splashes.
I slide off you.
I pull back, syrup stringing.
You push me, and your hand sinks in.
I'm squashed flat and slowly plump up.
You pull free, and the strands snap.
I stick your other foot.
You struggle, and the strands stretch long.
I press onto your back.

lines.zh: 你把我踩开，我又流回去。
lines.en: You stamp me away; I flow back.
Another caramel mass is bouncing too.
She's a size smaller and glossier.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，合成一团。
lines.en: We bump and merge into one mass.
Her sugar is richer.
We spread out on the ground together.
She shares a little; it's sweet.
We bounce together, in rhythm.
Her color is a little darker.

lines.zh: 我们合成一大团，又分开。
lines.en: We join into one mass, then part.
Two lumps of sugar, one sticky floor.
I absorb that lump of sugar.
I wrap around your dropped sword.

lines.zh: 我吞了一颗糖粒，慢慢化。
lines.en: I swallow a sugar grain and let it dissolve.
I stick your arrow to the floor.
I take up a piece of candy shell.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的帽子粘住了。
lines.en: I've stuck your fallen hat down.

lines.zh: 我把地上的糖浆收回来。
lines.en: I draw the syrup on the floor back in.

lines.zh: 我裹住一块石头，又吐了。
lines.en: I wrap a stone, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 我拖着一块骨头顶着走。
lines.en: I push a bone along.
I scrape up all the sugar bits.
Your sole has sunk into me.
Your foot is on my edge.
I've started bouncing.
My syrup is stuck to your soles.
This sugar is mine.
I gather toward you.
I drip down from the cave roof.
You've backed to the candy wall.

lines.zh: 我蓄满力，蹦得比之前高。
lines.en: I gather myself and bounce higher than before.
You can't run; the floor is sticky.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，糖丝拉得老长。
lines.en: I hop closer, dragging long threads of syrup.
You go left; I shift over.
The floor is sticky; you can't move fast.
I gather into a pool at your feet.
I bounce up and come down.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了糖壳，声音很大。
lines.en: You crack a candy shell; it's loud.
I've stuck one of your feet.
I wait for you to look down.
Bubbles rise on my surface.
The more you struggle, the stickier it gets.
I slam into you, sticky.
I wrap one of your legs.
I press on you, heavy.
That came with syrup.
I bounce into your chin.
You punch through me, and I close again.
I pull you down.
The stuck hand won't come up.

lines.zh: 我弹开又滚回来，黏你一手。
lines.en: I bounce off, roll back, and gum up your hand.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也黏住了。
lines.en: That one stuck me too.
A lump rises in the syrup.
I seep out from under a candy shell.
The cave is sickly sweet.
First I spread out to look around.
I'm small and soft; don't step on me.
I swell back to shape, bit by bit.
Footsteps; I heard them.
The sugar on me is still flowing.

lines.zh: 糖浆从缝里渗出来，我成形。
lines.en: Caramel seeps from the crack, and I take shape.
I make my first bounce.
The heat melts my sugar.
I fall and spread over a wide patch.
Water thins me out.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹散，糖浆溅了一墙。
lines.en: The blast disperses me, syrup on the wall.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，洞口慢慢合上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through, and the hole slowly closes.

lines.zh: 有光罩住我，我硬了一块。
lines.en: A light covers me, and part of me hardens.
Without sugar, I slowly dry.
Lightning strikes; my surface scorches.
There's no floor here to spread on.
